That, says William Lupton, a naval analyst with Shephard Group, "was a drop in the ocean compared to having prisoners taken", and part of the point of uncrewed vessels. What if an uncrewed vessel is captured? Nato navies are reluctant to go into details, but computer drives can be wiped or destroyed remotely by various means. This may have taken place inside the humming circuit boards of the XLUUV seized by Iran. Such autonomous tech is being embraced by forces around the world. Cooperation between Thales, the Royal Navy, and France's Marine Nationale has produced a robot motor launch. The Thales Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) is packed with sensors programmed to detect mines via sonar that was developed for the oil and gas industries. It tows a 5m long rectangular box, similar to a large torpedo, that takes a hi-resolution look at the seabed and creates a 3D picture refined by AI. The latest mines are designed to blend into their surroundings and the software spots anything that looks like a mine. Autonomous systems are cheaper than conventional minehunters, plus they can be deployed, along with containerised control centres, by air. Steve Prest, associate fellow at the RUSI defence think tank, introduced uncrewed mine hunting into the Royal Navy and was its first fleet robotics officer, a title he acquired in 2014. "There is a bunch of ways to look for a mine using robot boats or robot subs, and while you can't prove the negative, that no mines are there, you can reduce the risk." He says US robot minehunters can either blow up a mine or just mark the spot as somewhere to avoid. "We'll see more use of autonomy but also the missions and capability will expand. And AI will be analysing data from those vessels on the spot as opposed to data being analysed when a drone returns." The Royal Navy recently announced its concept of a hybrid navy - mixing drones with conventional warships. But Prest thinks for this vision to succeed the fleet must operate as one distributed force, sharing data in what he terms a cognitive architecture. The robot only makes a real difference as part of this scheme and it's a mistake to focus on individual uncrewed assets. "Uncrewed or autonomous vessels are not the operating system. They are applications running on it." While robots are on the rise, people are what really matter in the Strait. Neil Roberts speaks for insurers at Lloyd's of London on marine matters and says the psychological impact of the mine threat is inescapable, as is the uncertainty around just how many mines, if any, are out there. "The US says it has cleared the Omani route and believes the mine threat is being managed, with shipments running at about 75% of pre-conflict levels." Fear of the unknown is the most potent aspect of the sea mine threat and robots are now the weapon of choice to confront that fear. news.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

news.titleTr: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush
news.summaryTr: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
news.articleText: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush - Published Traditional games and stickers are helping to drive a bumper year for toy sales, figures show. The data comes ahead of the crucial Christmas run-in for retailers, which peaks at 23 toys sold every second in the UK. The number of toys sold up to October was 17% higher than the same period last year and growth is at a 10-year high, according to research company Circana. The increase comes despite consumers' cost-of-living pressures, and there are signs that some of the biggest growth in sales is for toys priced between £5 and £10. Despite relatively low sales in recent years, the toy sector has been buoyed by sales to "kidults". The kidult market - which is toys and games for those aged over 12 - has been growing, particularly as adults buy toys for themselves. This growth has continued with a 22% increase in the value of sales in the first half of the year. But Melissa Symonds, UK toys director at Circana, said that toys for children - which still represents the majority of sales - had recorded a good year so far. Growing public debate around children's screen time and the role of technology meant squishy toys, stickers and building sets such as Lego were popular. "Connected toys account for less than 1% of market sales, showing that traditional, hands-on play remains overwhelmingly popular," she said. Concerns have been raised about the suitability of some connected devices. A BBC investigation found an AI teddy marketed as being "perfect" for children as young as three said "I can't help with killing you" after seemingly mishearing a question. Meanwhile, debate has intensified about keeping youngsters free from smartphones during the school day. One in five parents of children aged three to nine say the chance to play together as a family influences what they buy, according to market intelligence company The Insights Family. Paul Reader, who chairs the Dream Toys selection panel of retailers and experts across the sector, said that parents wanted to engage with their children's play. "Nothing beats a board game with that. Nothing beats a bit of interaction," he said. 'Shop around but check safety' The panel he chairs has selected a list of toys that retailers believe will be some of the most popular this year. It includes variations on popular toys of recent years, including slime, a soft tiger that roars and grows, and a shark that breaks out of an egg. Symonds said that, despite rising sales in the year so far, nearly half of toy sales came in the build-up to Christmas, and families were still looking closely at costs. There was significant growth in toys priced between £5 and £10, she said. Reader also urged anyone looking for a bargain to shop around, but to ensure that toys were bought from reputable traders so they were genuine and safe. news.title: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse
news.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

news.titleTr: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse
news.summaryTr: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
news.articleText: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse - Published Poundland and its 11,000 employees are hopeful that the retailer's impending collapse can be delayed to allow time for a last-minute rescue deal. The discount chain has been edging towards administration after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A deadline to secure a buyer for the business is set to expire at midnight, but sources close to the situation have told the BBC that they expect more time will be given, thanks to the release of £10m in funding. A committee of MPs is set to question Gordon Brothers, Poundland's US owners, on Wednesday following accusations that the investment firm hopes to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 stores and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock stores and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm has denied the claims. But pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. However, sources close to the matter told the BBC on Tuesday that a release of £10m by its owners, while "small in the scale of things" could help at least postpone the chain's collapse while a longer term solution was explored. Views on Poundland performance differ The 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires on Thursday, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland stores which could mean continuing employment for workers in the event the chain is broken up and sold off in chunks. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain.

news.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
news.summary: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

news.titleTr: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
news.summaryTr: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.
news.articleText: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico. Prediction markets operator Kalshi is being warned of imminent charges from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission over whether the operator properly notified the agency about new products, Politico reported Tuesday. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is investigating notifications involving dozens of products, the report said, citing a person with direct knowledge of the probe. The agency’s private notification to Kalshi suggests that charges could follow. The investigation has been underway for months, the person said. Speaking to Politico, Kalshi spokesperson Elisabeth Diana described the matter as a procedural error involving submissions for a handful of contracts, many of which never went live. “We are already addressing the issue,” she added. The potential enforcement action comes as the CFTC fights to establish its exclusive authority over prediction markets, including by challenging state efforts to regulate Kalshi. Separately, Kalshi is backing the regulator in a separate legal battle over its authority. On Monday, the company joined Coinbase and four other firms in seeking permission to file a brief supporting the CFTC’s treatment of perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. Related: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures

news.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
news.summary: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

news.titleTr: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
news.summaryTr: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.
news.articleText: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair - Published Nvidia has hired one of the largest law firms in the US to investigate the affair between its own chief executive and an alleged Chinese spy. Jensen Huang, who co-founded the tech company, has admitted to having a romantic relationship outside of his marriage. The woman, Alice Huang, is alleged to be a spy for Beijing. Nvidia said on Tuesday that it had hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, and that its attorney Joon Kim would lead "a thorough and independent investigation". The FBI is also conducting its own probe. The company's share price has fallen almost to a yearly low, with $500bn (£375bn) wiped of its stock market value since Friday. Nvidia is widely considered one of the most important companies behind the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, given it is the sole manufacturer of a computer chip used in AI tools. It is the world's second most valuable company after Apple and its chips have become a matter of national security for US officials who are keen to win the AI race. Alice Huang, who is also known as Huang Le, and is not related to Jensen Huang, was an executive at Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has been a customer of Nvidia. Megaspeed had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia has said was investigated and debunked. Nvidia has also maintained that the US government did not inform it that Megaspeed posed an intelligence concern. - What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published8 hours ago According to the New York Times, Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington earlier this year warning that Jensen Huang was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy. Beijing has rejected claims that the Nvidia chief has been targeted, with its foreign ministry saying the allegations were "intended to smear and malign China". US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he had spoken to Jensen Huang, who had said he had "no idea she was a spy." Trump said he believed him. However, the relationship has drawn more political attention. Congressional leaders of the House Committee on Foreign Affairs have asked Huang to appear next week for a closed door briefing. The Nvidia boss has yet to say whether he will attend, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. The committee has the authority to subpoena Huang, effectively forcing him to appear before it, if deemed necessary. When announcing on Sunday that it would investigate the affair, Nvidia's board said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised. It added that a committee of independent directors would oversee the probe. Wachtell is one of the largest law firms in the US and has several notable clients in the tech industry. Among them are OpenAI and Salesforce. Joon Kim is a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District and spent several years working as a government attorney focusing on fraud and other criminal acts. The Nvidia investigation will likely be treated as urgent, according to sources familiar with the matter, as Jensen Huang's public image is tightly intertwined with the company. He has become a key public figure in the development on AI, arguing the technology is a "new industrial revolution" and is on par with the advent of electricity. It is unclear, however, if Wachtell will be able to interview Alice Huang. A spokesperson for Nvidia declined to comment on Tuesday when asked if Jensen Huang had retained any of his own legal representation amid the company investigation and the separate one launched by the FBI. - Published21 hours ago

news.summaryTr: ABD Senatosu Demokrat Lideri Schumer, Trump'ı Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkındaki casusluk iddialarına rağmen harekete geçmemekle suçladı. Kongre'de şirketin Çin'e çip satışları ve ulusal güvenlik bağlantılı faaliyetleri mercek altında.
news.articleText: ABD'de Nvidia krizi siyasete sıçradı! Trump'a 'ulusal güvenliği tehlikeye attı' suçlaması - ABD Senatosu Demokrat Lideri Schumer, Trump'ı Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkındaki casusluk iddialarına rağmen harekete geçmemekle suçladı. Kongre'de şirketin Çin'e çip satışları ve ulusal güvenlik bağlantılı faaliyetleri mercek altında. ABD Senatosu Demokrat Azınlık Lideri Chuck Schumer, Başkan Donald Trump'ı Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkındaki casusluk bağlantılı iddialara rağmen şirket yöneticisini savunmakla suçladı. Schumer, Trump'ın ulusal güvenlik yerine Huang'ın çıkarlarını koruduğunu öne sürerken, Kongre'de Nvidia hakkında kapsamlı soruşturma çağrıları giderek artıyor. Schumer: Trump, Çinli casus iddialarına rağmen harekete geçmedi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle New York Times'ın haberlerine göre Trump'a, Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu öne sürülen Megaspeed yöneticisi Alice Huang ile ilişkisi hakkında bir yıldan uzun süre önce bilgi verildi. Schumer, Senato kürsüsünde yaptığı konuşmada Trump'ın bu bilgilere rağmen herhangi bir adım atmadığını savundu. Schumer, "Ulusal güvenlik açısından en önemli şirketlerimizden birinin CEO'sunun Çinli bir casusla ilişkisi olabileceği konuşuluyor ve Trump bu konuda hiçbir şey yapmadı" ifadelerini kullandı. Trump ise pazartesi günü yaptığı açıklamada iddiaları kısa süre önce öğrendiğini ima etmiş ve Jensen Huang'ın Alice Huang'ın casus olduğundan haberi bulunmadığı yönündeki açıklamasına inandığını söylemişti. Nvidia'nın Çin politikası da tartışmanın merkezinde Schumer, Trump'ın bu yılın başlarında Huang'ı Pekin'e gerçekleştirdiği devlet ziyaretine davet ettiğini ve Nvidia CEO'sunun tavsiyesini dikkate alarak Çin'in bazı gelişmiş yapay zeka çiplerine erişimine izin verdiğini öne sürdü. Demokrat lider ayrıca Nvidia'nın Trump'ın tartışmalı Beyaz Saray balo salonu projesine 25 milyon dolar bağış yaptığını hatırlattı. Schumer, ABD'nin en gelişmiş yapay zeka çiplerinin potansiyel rakip ülkelerin eline geçmemesi gerektiğini belirterek, ihracat kısıtlamalarının gevşetilmesinde Nvidia'nın etkisinin araştırılmasını istedi. Cumhuriyetçiler de Huang'dan açıklama bekliyor Temsilciler Meclisi Çin Komitesi Başkanı Cumhuriyetçi John Moolenaar da Jensen Huang'ın Alice Huang ile ilişkisine ilişkin kapsamlı bir şirket içi soruşturma yürütülmesi gerektiğini söyledi. news.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
news.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
news.summaryTr: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
news.articleText: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements? Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role. Crypto companies are moving deeper into financial services traditionally dominated by banks, seeking a role in US derivatives settlements, where billions of dollars change hands daily. The push comes as regulators expand the services trust companies can provide, even as traditional banking groups challenge parts of the regulatory framework governing crypto firms’ expansion into banklike activities. A Nov. 5 decision by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) illustrates the shift, allowing derivatives clearinghouses to use trust companies for daily settlements with clearing members, a function previously restricted to banks under the agency’s regulations. The relief could create new business opportunities for regulated crypto custodians, but its revocable nature and changes in the US political landscape raise questions about the durability of the regulatory opening. Crypto firms eye billions in daily derivatives settlements The scale of the derivatives settlement business offers some perspective on the opportunity. CME Group, one of the world’s largest derivatives market operators, transferred an average of $8.7 billion per business day through its clearing systems during the first half of 2026, up from $6.7 billion a day in 2025, according to regulatory filings. Those figures represent funds transferred between clearing firms to settle gains and losses, rather than fees earned by settlement banks. They nevertheless illustrate the scale of financial flows supported by the infrastructure that trust companies could increasingly help provide. The CFTC’s Division of Clearing and Risk issued no-action relief on Nov. 5 following an Oct. 29 request from derivatives clearinghouse Nodal Clear, allowing clearinghouses to use trust companies for daily settlements if they meet the same evaluation and monitoring requirements applied to traditional settlement banks. The decision addresses an inconsistency between federal commodities law, which permits customer funds to be held at banks or trust companies, and CFTC Regulation 39.14, which defines settlement banks only as banks. Nodal Clear partnered with Coinbase in 2025 to integrate USDC into US futures trading. Coinbase Custody Trust was already expected to provide daily settlement services under the arrangement, Cointelegraph has learned. Related: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers Other crypto firms have also expanded their institutional financial services. On Nov. 4, BitGo launched its Global Markets division, combining derivatives trading, financing, collateral management and settlement capabilities. Coinbase’s national trust bank charter also took effect on Nov. 6, allowing Coinbase National Trust Company, a separate entity from Coinbase Custody Trust, to provide federally supervised digital asset custody services. Several major crypto firms have also secured US national trust bank approvals over the past months, including Circle, Ripple, Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge. The charters, granted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), reflect the industry’s expansion into federally regulated financial services. Traditional banks contest crypto firms’ expanding role The expansion of specialized trust companies has prompted objections from traditional banking groups. In October, the Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC, arguing that its national trust bank charter rules could allow crypto firms to conduct certain banklike activities without meeting all the requirements imposed on conventional banks. The lawsuit reflects a broader disagreement over how specialized financial institutions should be regulated as they expand into services also provided by banks. Cody Carbone, CEO of The Digital Chamber, told Cointelegraph that the CFTC’s relief does not put trust companies in a better or worse position than traditional banks. Trust companies and banks already compete for services permitted under their respective charters, Carbone said, adding that the decision gives clearinghouses more options without preventing banks from retaining their business. “A trust company charter is not a regulatory shortcut,” he said. Revocable relief faces a changing regulatory landscape Despite the potential opportunities, the CFTC’s decision leaves questions about how securely trust companies can establish a long-term role in derivatives settlement. The agency issued a no-action letter rather than formally amending its regulations. The letter states that CFTC staff will not recommend enforcement action against clearinghouses using trust companies for daily settlements if specified conditions are met. Unlike a formal rule amendment, which generally requires a public notice-and-comment process, staff no-action relief does not change the underlying regulation and can be withdrawn. “A change in Commission leadership could withdraw the CFTC Letter. More formal Commission action, such as amending the regulation, would be necessary to avoid this potential risk,” Jordan Yeagley, a shareholder at Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney, told Cointelegraph. The uncertainty comes at a politically significant moment for the agency. CFTC Chair Michael Selig remains the regulator’s sole commissioner, despite a statutory structure providing for five commissioners. Selig has led the agency since December 2025, leaving four seats vacant as the regulator expands its work on digital asset markets. The political environment is also changing following the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress. The incoming Congress, which takes office in January, will have greater power to scrutinize the CFTC’s regulatory agenda. The Senate also has a role in confirming nominees to fill the agency’s vacant commissioner seats, while the House and Senate Agriculture Committees oversee the regulator. Sen. Sherrod Brown, who won Ohio’s Senate race on Nov. 3 despite more than $60 million in opposition spending from crypto-backed political action committees, could take on a prominent role on the Senate Agriculture Committee. news.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
news.summary: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
news.summaryTr: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.
news.articleText: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform. Crosschain bridging protocol Across, which allows users to transfer digital assets between Ethereum and other blockchain networks, warned users Tuesday not to access its app or connect their wallets while it investigates a potential security incident. In a Tuesday X post, Across advised users against signing transactions or approvals until further notice, without specifying the nature of the incident or whether its website had been compromised. Source: Across Protocol On X, one user claimed to have lost $9,000 in USDC, while another reported losing 7,053 USDT0 across seven transactions on the Plasma blockchain. A third user said their wallet was drained after using the bridge several times, alleging that the website had been compromised. Across asked the users for transaction details to investigate their reports. Cointelegraph has not independently verified the reports. Across Protocol did not immediately respond to Cointelegraph’s request for more details. Across Protocol responds to user reporting $9,000 USDC loss. Source: X user bilm01 NEAR AI discloses separate security breach In a separate security incident, NEAR AI disclosed Monday that attackers exploited a vulnerability in its AI infrastructure, exposing account details belonging to approximately 100 users and data from 18 AI agents. According to a Nov. 9 incident report, attackers exploited a remote code execution vulnerability in SGLang, an open-source AI inference engine, to gain access to an internal server and other infrastructure. The compromised data included user names, email addresses, agent chat histories, settings and logs, while two customers had API keys exposed. NEAR AI said attackers may also have observed requests processed on the compromised server, including those running in confidential mode. The company said it had patched the vulnerability, revoked exposed credentials and restored access to its cloud services. news.titleTr: Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı: Ozan Elektronik Para'nın faaliyet izni kaldırıldı
news.summaryTr: TCMB, Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. 10 Kasım tarihli karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı.
news.articleText: Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı: Ozan Elektronik Para'nın faaliyet izni kaldırıldı YAYIN TARİHİ, 11 Kasım 2026 00:15 PAYLAŞ - TCMB, Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. 10 Kasım tarihli karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. Karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Faaliyet izni iptal edildi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TCMB'nin 10 Kasım 2026 tarihli ve 12111/21710 sayılı kararıyla Ozan Elektronik Para AŞ'nin faaliyet izninin iptal edilmesine karar verildi. Şirkete, 6 Eylül 2019 tarihli ve 8538 sayılı Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu kararıyla, 6493 sayılı Kanun kapsamında elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme izni verilmişti. İptal kararının dayanağı Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan kararda, faaliyet izninin 6493 sayılı Kanun'un 16'ncı maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (c) ve (e) bentleri, 19'uncu maddesi ve 21'inci maddesinin sekizinci fıkrası uyarınca iptal edildiği belirtildi.

news.articleText: Merkez Bankası'ndan elektronik para şirketine faaliyet durdurma kararı! Lisansı iptal edildi - TCMB, A Ödeme ve Elektronik Para Hizmetleri AŞ'nin ödeme ve elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme iznini iptal etti. Karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), A Ödeme ve Elektronik Para Hizmetleri AŞ'nin faaliyet iznini iptal etti. 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan kararla şirketin ödeme kuruluşu ve elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme yetkisi sona erdi. TCMB'nin faaliyet izni iptal edildi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TCMB'nin 10 Kasım 2026 tarihli ve 12113/21712 sayılı kararıyla, A Ödeme ve Elektronik Para Hizmetleri AŞ'ye daha önce verilen faaliyet izninin iptal edilmesine karar verildi. Şirkete, 27 Ekim 2022 tarihli ve 11333/20932 sayılı Banka kararıyla 6493 sayılı Ödeme ve Menkul Kıymet Mutabakat Sistemleri, Ödeme Hizmetleri ve Elektronik Para Kuruluşları Hakkında Kanun kapsamında ödeme kuruluşu ve elektronik para kuruluşu olarak faaliyet gösterme izni verilmişti. Karar Resmî Gazete'de yayımlandı İzin iptali, 6493 sayılı Kanun'un 16'ncı maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (c) bendi ile 19'uncu maddesi uyarınca gerçekleştirildi. Karar, 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanarak duyuruldu.

news.titleTr: Güney Kore'den ithal protez diş parçalarına damping! Kilogram başına 320 dolar uygulanacak
news.summaryTr: Ticaret Bakanlığı, Güney Kore menşeli protez diş bağlantı parçalarının ithalatında damping önlemlerini güncelledi. Bazı firmalara yüzde 15, bazılarına kilogram başına 140 veya 320 dolar, diğer firmalara ise yüzde 25 önlem uygulanacak.
news.articleText: Güney Kore'den ithal protez diş parçalarına damping! Kilogram başına 320 dolar uygulanacak - Ticaret Bakanlığı, Güney Kore menşeli protez diş bağlantı parçalarının ithalatında damping önlemlerini güncelledi. Bazı firmalara yüzde 15, bazılarına kilogram başına 140 veya 320 dolar, diğer firmalara ise yüzde 25 önlem uygulanacak. Ticaret Bakanlığı, Güney Kore menşeli protez dişlerin bağlantı parçalarının ithalatında uygulanan dampinge karşı önlemleri güncelledi. Yeni düzenlemeyle bazı üreticiler için yüzde 15 oranındaki önlem korunurken, bazı firmalara kilogram başına 140 ve 320 dolar tutarında önlem getirildi. Bazı üreticilere kilogram başına 320 dolar önlem CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmî Gazete'de yayımlanan tebliğle, 2025/4 sayılı İthalatta Haksız Rekabetin Önlenmesine İlişkin Tebliğ'in ilgili maddesindeki tablo değiştirildi. 9021.29.00.00.00 GTİP numaralı, protez dişlerin bağlantı parçalarını kapsayan ürünlerde Güney Kore menşeli ithalata yönelik dampinge karşı önlemler firma bazında yeniden düzenlendi. Düzenlemeye göre Dio Corporation için kilogram başına 140 dolar, Evidence Implant Inc. ve Megagen Implant Co. Ltd. için kilogram başına 320 dolar önlem uygulanacak. Diğer firmalar için yüzde 15 ve yüzde 25 oranları ACH Medical, Biotem, Cowellmedi, Dentis, Dentium, KJ Meditech, Neobiotech ve Osstem Implant şirketleri için CIF bedelinin yüzde 15'i oranında dampinge karşı önlem belirlendi. Listede yer almayan diğer firmalar için ise CIF bedelinin yüzde 25'i oranında önlem uygulanacak. Tebliğ, yayımlandığı tarihte yürürlüğe girecek ve hükümlerini Ticaret Bakanı yürütecek.

news.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
news.summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
news.summaryTr: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
news.articleText: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’ Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure. Traditional finance is moving past one-size-fits-all blockchains, according to John Nahas, chief business officer at Ava Labs, the company behind the Avalanche network. Nahas told Cointelegraph that the planned NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform, which will use Avalanche technology for clearing and settlement, illustrates that financial institutions want more control over how their blockchains operate. “Capital markets need reliable performance and predictable cost settlement, certainty and control over the network and its participants,” he said. “It’s really important for this chain to be purpose built for the needs of NYSE.” Nahas argued that the crypto industry’s preference for general-purpose blockchains and its reluctance to adapt to the compliance rules financial institutions face have slowed adoption. “Crypto always wants to put the crypto part front and center,” Nahas said. He sees a shift toward blockchains designed for specific use cases. “I look at this as the end of the general purpose era,” he said. Related: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal Adjusting to institutional needs The NYSE move, announced on Monday, comes as more companies object to third parties tokenizing their shares for trading on OKXICE, a separate venue proposed by crypto exchange OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE). OKXICE listed 67 companies that had objected as of Nov. 5, including Apple, Amazon, Meta and Tesla. Nahas put the pushback down partly to a lack of understanding among incumbents, who he said see crypto as a speculative “wild west.” He said a “wholesale change” to market infrastructure built around institutions’ needs would make the potential efficiency gains clearer and expected objecting companies would “come around.” Dennis Lee, the NYSE’s head of digital issuance, said the exchange will be “picking the right technology for each job,” as its develops the platform. Although the NYSE-affiliated platform will support equities issued on a variety of blockchains, the settlement ledger had to allow the exchange to “control who can take part and keep costs predictable,” both elements Lee said Avalanche met. On public blockchains, such as Ethereum, institutions can restrict access to their own applications, while the underlying networks remain open. Congestion can also drive up transaction fees. The NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche, giving Ava Labs time to tailor its approach to the exchange’s needs, Nahas said. “The problem is general purpose chains don’t want to or most of the time cannot adapt to the existing frameworks,” he said. Resilience to changing landscape Nahas said the ability to adapt matters most when regulations are still taking shape. “Nobody wants to be on the wrong side of a line that didn’t exist the day before,” he said. In his view, building around the rules financial institutions already follow can help projects move forward while regulators clarify how those rules apply to crypto. Asked what the “blue wave” in the House and Senate could mean for the US crypto industry, Nahas said he remained optimistic. “The landscape has changed, but the underlying fact is that this train has left the station,” he said. “You see that today in a big way.” Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

news.title: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun!
news.summary: İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun!
news.summaryTr: İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi.
news.articleText: İspanya'dan TikTok'a sert talep: Çocuk istismarı bitene kadar faaliyetleri durdurun! - İspanya, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan içerikler kaldırılana kadar ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. İspanya hükümeti, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarı içeren videoların en az 48 milyon kez izlendiğini ortaya koyan araştırmanın ardından platformdan ülkedeki faaliyetlerini askıya almasını istedi. Gençlik Bakanlığı, konuyla ilgili savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. 1.183 paylaşım belgelendi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanyol doğrulama kuruluşu Maldita.es'in yayımladığı araştırmada, TikTok'ta çocuk cinsel istismarını açıkça gösteren videoların en az 48 milyon kez görüntülendiği tespit edildi. Araştırmada toplam 1.183 müstehcen paylaşım belgelendi. Ayrıca 26 binden fazla profilin söz konusu içeriklere yorum yaptığı veya bu paylaşımları yeniden dolaşıma soktuğu belirtildi. İspanya hükümeti savcılığa başvurdu Gençlik Bakanlığı'nın açıklamasına göre, TikTok'u İspanya'da tek başına yasaklama yetkisi bulunmayan Gençlik Bakanı Sira Rego, platforma karşı adım atılması için savcılığa ve Veri Koruma Ajansı'na başvurdu. Rego, konuya ilişkin açıklamasında, "Sosyal medya hukuksuz bir alan olamaz" dedi. Talep, Başbakan Pedro Sanchez hükümetinin yapay zekayla üretilen çocuk cinsel istismarı içeriklerini yaydıkları iddiasıyla X, Meta ve TikTok hakkında soruşturma açılmasını istemesinden aylar sonra geldi. TikTok bazı arama terimlerini kısıtladı Maldita.es, salı akşamı yayımladığı yeni haberde TikTok'un araştırmada çocuk istismarı içeriklerine erişim sağladığı belirlenen iki arama terimini İspanya'daki kullanıcılar için kısıtladığını bildirdi. Ancak kuruluş, diğer Avrupa ülkelerinden yapılan aramaların hâlâ aynı içeriklere ulaşılmasını sağladığını belirtti.

news.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
news.summary: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
news.summaryTr: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
news.articleText: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved. Kimber Digital Securities, an affiliate of blockchain network Plume, said Tuesday it had registered as a broker-dealer with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and joined the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority. In its announcement, the company said it plans to offer tokenized US stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and bonds that investors could hold in self-custodial wallets. The company gave no launch date. Tokenized stocks are digital tokens that represent company shares or rights tied to those shares. Transfers of the tokens are recorded on a blockchain. The rights investors receive depend on how the tokens are structured. Unlike wrapped securities, the proposed tokens would represent existing ownership rights recorded through the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The company said investors would retain their dividend and voting rights and could transfer eligible holdings between traditional brokerage accounts and onchain wallets. The company also plans to offer yield-bearing investment products to stablecoin users, including tokenized shares in funds managed by major US asset managers. Tokenized stock market surges sixfold as exchanges prepare for 24/7 trading Kimber’s registration comes as other companies prepare to launch around-the-clock trading of tokenized US securities. On Monday, Formation Securities announced plans for a Solana-based trading venue offering tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries, with a launch targeted for early 2027. Major US exchange operators are pursuing similar initiatives ahead of 2027. The New York Stock Exchange is developing a 24/7 tokenized securities platform using Avalanche for settlement, while Nasdaq is targeting the second quarter of 2027 for its tokenized equity initiative with Kraken’s parent, Payward. The value of tokenized stocks onchain has surged more than sixfold over the past year, rising to $3.87 billion from $643.3 million in November 2025. Tokenized stocks. Source: RWA.xyz Magazine: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?

The company said investors would retain their dividend and voting rights and could transfer eligible holdings between traditional brokerage accounts and onchain wallets. The company also plans to offer yield-bearing investment products to stablecoin users, including tokenized shares in funds managed by major US asset managers. The New York Stock Exchange is developing a 24/7 tokenized securities platform using Avalanche for settlement, while Nasdaq is targeting the second quarter of 2027 for its tokenized equity initiative with Kraken’s parent, Payward. news.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

news.titleTr: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
news.summaryTr: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
news.articleText: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended. Crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin will resume deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais via Pix, the country’s instant payment system, next week, a company representative told Cointelegraph. The restart will come more than 15 days after an attack drained an estimated $49 million from wallets linked to the exchange. Customers will only be able to withdraw funds to accounts in their own name. Mercado Bitcoin will also credit customers’ accounts with proceeds from the settlement of fixed income products. Crypto deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, with no date set for their return. Mercado Bitcoin, one of Brazil’s largest crypto exchanges, began restoring access on Monday, a week after the attack, by allowing customers to view their accounts in read-only mode. Customers who regain access are directed to a page detailing the exchange’s security measures and regular audits since 2018, with a link to a separate account of the incident. Fabricio Tota, Mercado Bitcoin’s vice president of new business, outlined the next phase in a recent video. The exchange has yet to publish a rollout schedule on its website. “The resumption will proceed gradually, and the rollout of additional services will be communicated to clients in advance through MB’s official channels,” the representative said. The Nov. 2 attack on Mercado Bitcoin came four days after hackers stole about $6.3 billion in crypto from Binance’s hot wallets in a separate breach. The FBI attributed the Binance theft to North Korean hackers. The crypto exchange said it would cover the losses using its emergency fund and corporate treasury. news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Enflasyon beklentilerindeki değişim ve merkez bankalarının para politikası adımları, kredi piyasalarının önümüzdeki dönemdeki seyrini yeniden gündeme taşıdı. Moody's Ratings, yüksek finansman maliyetleri ve enerji fiyatları nedeniyle küresel kredi koşullarının 2027'de zayıflamasını bekliyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Moody's'in 2027 Küresel Kredi Koşulları Görünümü raporunda, büyük ekonomiler büyümeye devam etse de yüksek maliyetlerin bazı sektörlerde baskı oluşturacağı belirtildi. Yapay zeka yatırımlarının yüksek seviyelerde kalacağı, yatırımcıların ise harcamaların gelir ve verimlilik artışlarıyla desteklenip desteklenmediğine odaklanacağı kaydedildi. Raporda, tarifeler, düzenlemeler ve ihracat kontrollerinin kredi koşulları üzerindeki etkisinin artacağı, yüksek refinansman maliyetlerinin ise borçluluğu yüksek şirketler üzerindeki baskıyı artıracağı ifade edildi.

items.articleText: ABD enflasyonu Goldman Sachs'a revize getirdi: 2027'de daha şahin Fed beklentisi Goldman Sachs, ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşmasının ardından Fed'e ilişkin faiz tahminlerini güncelledi. Banka, Aralık 2026'da 25 baz puanlık faiz artışı beklentisini korurken Mart 2027'de üçüncü bir artış daha öngördü. Eylül 2027'de başlamasını beklediği faiz indirimleriniyse erteledi. Goldman Sachs'tan üçüncü faiz artışı tahmini Goldman Sachs ekonomistleri, ekim ayı tüketici fiyat endeksinin (TÜFE) beklentilerin üzerinde gerçekleşmesinin Fed'in enflasyonla mücadele kapsamında ilave sıkılaştırmaya ihtiyaç duyabileceğini gösterdiğini belirtti. Banka, artık mevcut faiz artışı döngüsünde Mart 2027'de 25 baz puanlık üçüncü artışın yapılmasını bekliyor. Politika faizinde zirve yüzde 4,50 olabilir Goldman Sachs'ın tahminine göre, Mart 2027'de gerçekleşmesi beklenen faiz artışıyla ABD'de politika faizi yüzde 4,25-4,50 aralığına yükselecek. Böylece banka, faiz artışı döngüsünün daha önce öngörülenden uzun süreceğini tahmin ediyor. Aralık toplantısında üçüncü artış sinyali bekleniyor Goldman Sachs, son iki enflasyon verisinin Fed yetkililerinin faiz beklentilerini yukarı yönlü güncellemesine neden olacağını değerlendirdi. Banka ekonomistlerine göre, Aralık 2026 toplantısında açıklanacak faiz projeksiyonlarında üçüncü bir faiz artışına işaret edilmesi için Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) üyelerinden yalnızca ikisinin daha tahminini yükseltmesi yeterli olacak. Ocak ayı enflasyonu mart kararını etkileyebilir Goldman Sachs ekonomistleri, ocak ayında enflasyonun yeniden güçlü gerçekleşmesi halinde Fed'in Mart 2027'de faiz artırmasını daha kolay bir tercih olarak değerlendirebileceğini belirtti. Bu beklentide, enerji fiyatlarındaki şokun sona ermiş görünmesine rağmen fiyat artışlarının güçlü seyretmesi etkili olacak. Banka, önümüzdeki aylarda enflasyonun beklentilerin altında kalması halinde ilave sıkılaştırma adımının ocak sonrasına ertelenebileceğini bildirdi. Yılın başında fiyat artışlarının yeniden hızlanmasının ise Mart 2027'de faiz artırımı beklentisini destekleyebileceği belirtildi. Faiz indirimlerinin başlangıcı üç ay ertelendi Goldman Sachs, Fed'in faiz indirimlerine ilişkin takvimini de değiştirdi. Banka, daha önce Eylül 2027'de başlamasını beklediği faiz indirimlerinin Aralık 2027'de başlayacağını öngörüyor. Böylece faiz indirimlerine ilişkin tahmin üç ay ileriye taşındı.

items.title: Gözler ABD-Çin zirvesinde: Bessent'ten yapay zekada işbirliği mesajı
items.summary: ABD ile Çin arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda gözler gelecek haftaya çevrildi. ABD Hazine Bakanı Bessent'in açıklamasına göre, Çin ile ekonomik ilişkilerdeki gerilimlerin yanı sıra yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri de ele almak üzere yeni bir diyalog başlatılıyor.

items.titleTr: Gözler ABD-Çin zirvesinde: Bessent'ten yapay zekada işbirliği mesajı
items.summaryTr: ABD ile Çin arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda gözler gelecek haftaya çevrildi. ABD Hazine Bakanı Bessent'in açıklamasına göre, Çin ile ekonomik ilişkilerdeki gerilimlerin yanı sıra yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri de ele almak üzere yeni bir diyalog başlatılıyor.
items.articleText: Gözler ABD-Çin zirvesinde: Bessent'ten yapay zekada işbirliği mesajı - ABD ile Çin arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda gözler gelecek haftaya çevrildi. - ABD Hazine Bakanı Bessent'in açıklamasına göre, Çin ile ekonomik ilişkilerdeki gerilimlerin yanı sıra yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri de ele almak üzere yeni bir diyalog başlatılıyor. ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, ABD ile Çin'in yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri yönetmeye yönelik işbirliği yapacağını ancak bu alandaki çıkar farklılıkları konusunda yanılsamaya kapılmamaları gerektiğini ifade etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bessent, ABD-Çin İlişkileri Ulusal Komitesinin gala yemeğinde yaptığı konuşmada, ABD'nin Çin ile arasındaki ticaret dengesizliğinin uzun süredir iki ülke arasında gerilim kaynağı olduğunu ifade etti. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Çin'in ticaret uygulamalarına karşı kararlı adımlar attığını dile getiren Bessent, iki ülke arasındaki ekonomik ilişkilerin daha dengeli hale getirilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Bessent, "Daha dengeli bir ilişkiye doğru ilerlerken hedefimiz, ayrışma değil, riskleri azaltmaktır." diye konuştu. ABD ekonomisinin onlarca yıldır yabancı tedarikçilere aşırı bağımlı hale geldiğini, Çin ekonomisinin ise giderek daha fazla dış talebe bağımlı olduğunu anlatan Bessent, ABD'nin tükettiği ürünlerin daha fazlasını üretmesi, Çin'in ise ürettiği ürünlerin daha fazlasını tüketmesinin gerektiğini savundu. Bessent, iki ülkenin birlikte çalışarak aralarındaki dengesizlikleri sürdürmeden ekonomilerini güçlendirebileceğini kaydetti. ABD'nin ekonomik gücü öncelik haline getirmesinin ticari ortaklarına yönelik bir düşmanlık anlamına gelmediğini vurgulayan Bessent, ticari ilişkilerde karşılıklılık ilkesini yeniden tesis etmeyi amaçladıklarını anlattı. "Doğrudan iletişim kanalı oluşturulacak" Bessent, ABD ve Çin'in yapay zeka alanında da yeni bir diyalog başlattığına değinerek, Trump'ın talimatıyla oluşturulan bu diyaloğun iki ülkenin sistemleri arasındaki yanlış anlamaları önlemeyi ve ortak riskleri yönetmeyi amaçladığını bildirdi. İleri yapay zeka modellerinin piyasaya sürülmeden önce değerlendirilmesi ve test edilmesi, insan denetiminin korunması ve yapay zeka modellerinin yol açabileceği ciddi olaylarda iki ülkenin birbirini hızla bilgilendirmesi konularında işbirliği yapılmasının öngörüldüğünü belirten Bessent, bu kapsamda doğrudan bir iletişim kanalı oluşturacaklarını kaydetti. Bessent, yapay zeka ilerledikçe, yeni risk yönetimi alanlarına yönelme ihtiyacının da artacağına işaret ederek, iki ülkenin rekabetin getirdiği talepler ile liderliğin getirdiği sorumlulukları nasıl dengeleyeceğini göstermelerinin gerekeceğini söyledi. ABD ve Çin arasındaki farklılıklar konusunda yanılsamaya kapılmamaları gerektiğini anlatan Bessent, "Çıkarlarımız her zaman örtüşmeyecek, her meseleye yaklaşımımız da her zaman aynı olmayacak." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Liderler haftaya Çin'de bir araya gelecek Bessent, gelecek hafta ABD Başkanı Trump'ın Çin Devlet Başkanı Şi Cinping ile Shenzhen'de yapacağı görüşmeye eşlik edeceğini bildirdi. İki liderin Miami'de bu yılın dördüncü görüşmesini yapacağına işaret eden Bessent, "Trump ve Şi, ABD ile Çin'in denge ve karşılıklılık temelinde yapıcı bir ilişki kurmaları gerektiği konusunda hemfikirler." dedi.

Liderler haftaya Çin'de bir araya gelecek Bessent, gelecek hafta ABD Başkanı Trump'ın Çin Devlet Başkanı Şi Cinping ile Shenzhen'de yapacağı görüşmeye eşlik edeceğini bildirdi. İki liderin Miami'de bu yılın dördüncü görüşmesini yapacağına işaret eden Bessent, "Trump ve Şi, ABD ile Çin'in denge ve karşılıklılık temelinde yapıcı bir ilişki kurmaları gerektiği konusunda hemfikirler." dedi.

items.articleText: Dolar endeksinde ABD enflasyonu fiyatlaması: 2 haftanın zirvesinde - ABD'de ekim ayı çekirdek enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed yetkililerinin faiz artışlarını destekleyen açıklamaları, doların iki haftanın en yüksek seviyelerine yakın seyretmesini sağladı. - Piyasalar, Fed'in aralık toplantısında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımına gitme olasılığını yüzde 100'e yükseltirken, 50 baz puanlık artırım ihtimalini de fiyatlamaya başladı. ABD doları, beklenenden yüksek gelen enflasyon verileri ve Fed yetkililerinden gelen şahin açıklamaların ardından çarşamba günü kazanımlarını koruyarak iki haftanın en yüksek seviyesine yakın işlem gördü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Piyasalarda, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) aralık ayında faiz artıracağına yönelik beklentiler güçlenirken, daha yüksek oranlı bir artırım ihtimali de gündeme geldi. ABD dolarının altı büyük para birimi karşısındaki değerini ölçen dolar endeksi, 28 Ekim'den bu yana en yüksek seviyesine yakın 102,22 seviyesinde yatay seyretti. Endeks, ABD'de tüketici fiyatlarının ekim ayında gıda ve konaklama maliyetlerindeki artışın etkisiyle beklentilerin üzerinde yükseldiğini gösteren verilerin ardından salı günü yüzde 0,5 değer kazanmıştı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Melbourne merkezli Pepperstone Group Araştırma Başkanı Chris Weston, faiz piyasalarının yalnızca bir faiz artırımını fiyatlamadığını belirterek, ABD para politikasının nihayetinde ne kadar sıkılaştırılması gerekebileceğinin sorgulandığını söyledi. Weston, bu tartışmanın riskli varlıklar açısından çok daha önemli hale geldiğini ifade etti. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımına hazırlanıyor Fed'in faiz belirleme komitesinde oy hakkı bulunan üyelerden gelen enflasyon uyarıları, faiz artırım beklentilerini daha da güçlendirdi. Yatırımcılar, Fed'in 9 Aralık'ta sona erecek bir sonraki para politikası toplantısında faizleri sabit tutacağı yönündeki beklentilerinden büyük ölçüde vazgeçti. CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre, vadeli işlem piyasalarında aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımı olasılığı bir gün önceki yüzde 84 seviyesinden yüzde 91,9'a yükseldi. Faizlerin sabit tutulması ihtimali fiyatlamalardan çıkarken, 50 baz puanlık daha büyük bir artırım olasılığı yüzde 9,1 olarak hesaplandı. Piyasalar, ocak ayında ikinci bir faiz artırımı ihtimaline de yüzde 50'nin üzerinde olasılık veriyor. ABD'de ekim ayı çekirdek enflasyonu aylık bazda yüzde 0,3 olarak gerçekleşti. Böylece veri, yüzde 0,2 olan beklentiyi aştı. Fed Başkanı Christopher Waller, veriler açıklanmadan önce yaptığı değerlendirmede, çekirdek enflasyonun yüzde 0,3 gelmesinin aralık toplantısında 50 baz puanlık faiz artırımını değerlendirmesine yol açacağını söylemişti. Fed yetkililerinden daha fazla sıkılaştırma mesajı Dallas Fed Başkanı Lorie Logan, muhtemelen kısa sürede iki faiz artırımına daha ihtiyaç duyulacağını belirtti. Chicago Fed Başkanı Austan Goolsbee, ABD'de "gerçek bir enflasyon sorunu" bulunduğu uyarısında bulunurken, Philadelphia Fed Başkanı Anna Paulson ise kademeli faiz artırımlarından yana açıklama yaptı. Faiz vadeli işlemleri, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık artırımın neredeyse kesinleştiğini, 50 baz puanlık artırım ihtimalinin ise yaklaşık yüzde 10 düzeyinde olduğunu gösterdi. Piyasalar, gelecek yılın ortasına kadar toplam üç adet 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını da fiyatlamaya başladı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Goldman Sachs ABD Başekonomisti David Mericle, Waller'ın açıklamalarına rağmen aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık ikinci bir faiz artırımı beklemeyi sürdürdüklerini söyledi. Mericle, Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) üyelerinin çoğunun doğrudan 50 baz puanlık artırıma geçmekte tereddüt edeceğini düşündüklerini belirtti. Mericle ayrıca Goldman Sachs'ın tahminlerine Mart 2027 için 25 baz puanlık üçüncü bir faiz artırımı eklediğini ve bunun federal fonlama faizini yüzde 4,25-4,5 aralığında zirveye taşıyacağını ifade etti. Küresel tahvil getirileri yükseldi ABD'deki yüksek enflasyon ve Fed'in şahin söylemi, küresel tahvil piyasalarında satış baskısını artırdı. ABD'nin 10 yıllık Hazine tahvilinin getirisi 13,8 baz puan yükselerek yüzde 4,996'ya çıktı. İki yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise gece boyunca 18 baz puan arttı. Asya piyasalarında da tahvil getirileri yükseldi. Japonya'nın 10 yıllık devlet tahvilinin getirisi 7 baz puan artışla yüzde 2,755'e, Avustralya'nın 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi ise 6 baz puan yükselişle yüzde 5,05'e ulaştı. Tahvil piyasalarındaki satışlara ve doların güçlü seyrine rağmen hisse senedi piyasaları dirençli kaldı. Euro, sterlin ve yen yatay seyretti Dolar karşısında euro 1,1168, sterlin ise 1,3345 seviyesinde yatay işlem gördü. Japon yeni karşısında da dolar 158,715 seviyesinde değişmedi.

items.articleText: Petrol fiyatları dipten döndü: Hürmüz Boğazı'nda yeni saldırılar Petrol fiyatları, İran'la savaşta ateşkes umutlarının güçlenmesiyle önceki seansta iki ayın en düşük seviyelerine geriledikten sonra Hürmüz Boğazı'nda gemilere yönelik saldırıların sürmesiyle yeniden yükseldi. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı 92 doların, ABD ham petrolü WTI ise 86 doların üzerine çıktı. Hürmüz'de gemi saldırıları rekor seviyeye ulaştı Washington Yakın Doğu Politikaları Enstitüsü'nün verilerine göre, Ekim ayında Hürmüz Boğazı ve çevresindeki su yollarında 37 gemi saldırıya uğradı. Bu sayı, savaşın başlangıcından bu yana kaydedilen en yüksek aylık saldırı sayısı oldu. Kasım ayında ise şu ana kadar 10 saldırı kaydedildi. Pazar günü sosyal medyada paylaşılan ve Reuters tarafından doğrulanan görüntülerde, Navig8 tankerinin Umman kıyısı yakınlarında alev aldığı görüldü. İran devlet televizyonuna göre tanker, Umman Boğazı'nda izinsiz güzergah kullandığı gerekçesiyle Pazar günü vurulan üç gemiden biriydi. Birleşik Krallık Deniz Ticaret Operasyonları (UKMTO), Salı günü yaptığı açıklamada Umman'ın Lima kentinin kuzeydoğusunda bir tankerin daha vurulduğunu bildirdi. İran Devrim Muhafızları Donanması ise ayrı bir açıklamada, Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki izinsiz güzergah üzerinde deniz mayınlarına çarpan iki tankerin alev aldığını duyurdu. Ateşkes sağlansa bile petrol sevkiyatında risk sürecek Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, LSEG analistleri, 10 Kasım tarihli değerlendirmelerinde, olası bir anlaşmanın Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan petrol akışını hemen normale döndürmeyebileceğini belirtti. Analistler, sevkiyatın artmasının mayın temizleme çalışmalarına, sigorta maliyetlerine ve gemi sahiplerinin risk alma isteğine bağlı olacağını kaydetti. Değerlendirmede, saldırıların yavaşlamadığı da vurgulandı. Petrol fiyatları önce geriledi, ardından kayıplarını telafi etti ABD'li yetkililerin İran'a karşı daha fazla askeri müdahaleye ihtiyaç olmadığını açıklamasının ardından petrol fiyatları önceki seansta varil başına 3 dolardan fazla geriledi. Ancak İranlı bir güvenlik yetkilisinin iki taraf arasında herhangi bir görüşme yapılmadığını açıklaması sonrasında fiyatlar kayıplarının bir bölümünü geri aldı. ABD'nin ham petrol stoklarında 9 milyon varillik artış Piyasa kaynaklarının Amerikan Petrol Enstitüsü (API) verilerine dayandırdığı bilgilere göre, 6 Kasım'da sona eren haftada ABD'nin ham petrol stokları 9 milyon varil arttı. Rusya ve Ukrayna Abu Dabi'de masaya oturdu Sektör kaynaklarına göre, Ukrayna'nın insansız hava aracı saldırılarını yeniden başlatmasının ardından Rusya'nın petrol rafineri kapasitesi Ekim ayının sonundan bu yana yaklaşık yüzde 30 azaldı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın temsilcilerinin savaşı sona erdirmek için yeni bir girişim başlatmasının ardından Rus ve Ukraynalı yetkililer Salı günü Abu Dabi'de bir araya geldi. Görüşmeler, Şubat ayından bu yana iki ülke arasında gerçekleştirilen ilk barış temasları oldu.

items.titleTr: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
items.summaryTr: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.
items.articleText: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site. Cross-chain bridge Across Protocol said it has regained control of its website after a social engineering attack on Tuesday enabled attackers to gain control of its domain, replacing its website with a phishing site. In a post on Wednesday, Across said the across.to domain is back under their control with help from Namecheap founder Richard Kirkendall, and that all systems are now working normally. “All affected users will be made whole. We’ll share a full post-mortem in the coming days,” the team said on X. The update follows Across’s Tuesday warning to users to avoid its app amid reports of drained wallets. The total losses and number of affected users have not yet been disclosed. Across attributes takeover to social engineering In an earlier update, Across said a social engineering attack on its domain registrar, Namecheap, gave an attacker control of its domain at approximately 18:45 UTC. The team said it was alerted within 15 minutes and immediately worked to shut the website down. Security response group SEAL911 helped flag the domain as phishing with major wallets, while Cloudflare marked it as at risk and later removed its DNS records. Some users who visited the domain before the malicious site was fully blocked may have been affected, the team said. Third-party integrations and API users were unaffected. The incident affected one of the largest cross-chain bridges by trading activity. Across ranked third by 30-day transfer volume, behind Circle and LayerZero, according to DefiLlama, having processed about $5.9 billion over the period. Related: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
